title: Full-coverage subconscious recall measured 0.583 over batch-ingest KB; inject-concurrency refactor keeps health responsive
summary: Ran the full 1322-note cmm-onboard (D-zonoid-lib 1224 + D-zonoid-routes 98, deduped by name+file) through the NEW /overlay/notes/bulk path on an isolated test daemon (ORCH_PORT=8788, ORCH_DATA=temp, launched from worktree codex/inject-concurrency-batch-ingest). REFACTOR VERDICT: PROVEN. Bulk ingest of all 1322 notes completed cleanly (created:1322, HTTP 200) and /health stayed ok:true across 15/15 concurrent samples with ZERO errors and zero failed-request — the old path degraded health and aborted at 863. The /embed-batch (batch) path was used: with MiniLM ready, a single stable sidecar served the whole run (0 re-spawns during bulk), bulk took 72s for the real-embed run. NOTE on isolation: the IPC pipe name is salted by sha1(ORCH_DATA) (lib/ipc-path.js), so the test sidecar never collided with prod's pipe; data dir, daemon.pid, and model cache are all ORCH_DATA-scoped (runtime-paths.resolveDataDir honors ORCH_DATA first). Prod (:8787) was untouched the entire run. GOTCHA: the attempt worktree had NO node_modules (never npm-installed), so the sidecar's import('@xenova/transformers') failed with 'Cannot find package' and embeddings fell back to per-text embed() which ALSO failed -> vectors null -> a first run measured only LEXICAL (rrf-bm25) recall 0.378. NODE_PATH does NOT fix ESM bare-specifier resolution; a directory junction of prod node_modules into the worktree did. MEASUREMENT (semantic, same method as the 0.513 baseline: /search k=8 top-6 titles -> cmm get_code_snippet .source -> concat cap 12000 -> identifier-token recall over 13-query corpus): mean_recall 0.583, mean_tokens 1656, mean_tok_per_correct 835, hits 10-of-13. vs 65%-coverage baseline (0.513 / 1314 / 608 / 9-of-13): FULL COVERAGE LIFTED RECALL +0.070 (+13.6% rel) and hits 9->10; tokens/tok-per-correct rose because more relevant symbols now resolve to real snippets (e.g. q01 createWorktree/worktreePath/branchName all surface semantically -> recall 1.0 at lowest 277 tok-per-correct).
